questions.stem: Interpreting a graph, explain why raising spending and taxes equally still boosts output.

answer.exemplar: Equal spending and tax changes leave disposable income lower, but the full spending enters demand while only part of the tax reduces consumption, so net demand rises by the spending amount.

questions.explanation: The balanced-budget multiplier is one because spending enters demand fully while taxes reduce consumption by only the MPC fraction. The tempting zero answer ignores this asymmetry.
